title: Content Upload
content: # **Objective** Upload your files to CLO-SET to start collaborating. 1. Upload in Workroom or Company Library * Create New Workroom * Upload File(s) * Upload Turntable Images * Create Blank Content 2. Drag & Drop to Upload 3. Direct Upload from CLO3D 4. Content Type & ID 5. Troubleshooting # **Details** ### 1) Upload in Workroom 1\. To upload Content(s), go to the [Workroom](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) or [Company Library.](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191826841) *Uploading can only be done in Workroom or Company Library. 2\. Click '**\+ NEW** ' button at the top left corner. Select upload option from the drop-down list. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778843312025) * #### **Create New Workroom** * Create a child-workroom (a sub-folder within your Workroom) * #### **Upload File(s)** * Upload single or multiple files to your Workroom/Company Library. Find the list of **[supported file formats](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303203188121)** in CLO-SET [3D Viewer](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153968537). You can upload other file types, but may not be able to preview the file in 3D Viewer. * Select the file(s) to upload, and confirm the list and options. Click 'Upload' | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778812386201) | 1. 1. **File Information** * Extension and file type icon * File name * File size 2. #### **Do not notify Admins & Collaborators** * On: notification NOT sent * Off: notification sent 3. #### **Auto-Naming** * On: automatically assign Content Name as '_File Name_User ID_date_number'_ * Off: use original file name ---|---|--- * * You may exit the Workroom page once the uploading task is initiated. You may NOT cancel the upload once you see the upload progress bar at the bottom-right corner.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778781190041) * #### **Upload Turntable Images** * Select the Content Type. Which Content Type is the original file of this turntable image? * Select the list of files, and enter Colorway Name | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778804166041) | 1. Upload Turntable Images * Unzip Render Turntable files from CLO or CLO-SET, and select the list of images for each Colorway. 2. Insert name of Colorway 3. Select Upload options * Do not notify Admins & Collaborators * Auto-Naming ---|---|--- * * Once uploaded, review the file in Turntable format per Colorway. * #### **Create Blank Content** * Create a 'Blank Content', or a placeholder for your team to upload specific files. * Select the [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) of the file to be uploaded. ### 2) Drag & Drop to Upload ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778804429849) * Drag & Drop File(s) to the Workroom to upload. * Can ONLY upload to the Workroom you are in. To upload the files into the Child Workroom, please first enter the Child Workroom. * Upload options (Do not notify collaborators, Auto-Naming) will follow your last saved option. Default setting is 'Off'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778827961881) ### 3) Direct Upload from CLO3D * Learn how to **[upload your files directly from CLO3D software to CLO-SET.](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303203672473)** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778815742233) ### 4) Content Type & ID * Learn the classification of [Content Types](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) and the naming convention of [Content ID](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) in CLO-SET. ![Table \(1\) copy.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778815871385) ### 5) Troubleshooting * Please check your **permission**. Users without upload permission will NOT be able to use the drag & drop upload feature. * Permissions: Admin, Collaborator, Editor, Viewer (enable upload) can upload files. * If ANY of your **file names** include special characters, please remove them. * If ANY of your **file size** exceeds 1GB, uploading is not possible. ![스크린샷 2024-02-16 오후 2.49 1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778845198105) ![스크린샷 2024-02-19 오전 9.37 1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778816280729) *If any of your files include unsupported special characters or exceed the file size limit, upload action will be cancelled. * For further issues, please [submit a ticket](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new) with the Workroom URL.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to guide users through the process of uploading files to CLO-SET for effective collaboration in a Workroom or Company Library.
